job.job_description:
WALKIN DRIVE IN NOIDA ON 22-AUG-2026




AI/ML Engineer (GenAI)

Experience: 5+ Years


Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer with strong expertise in Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI to design, develop, and deploy scalable AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in building GenAI applications, implementing MLOps practices, and deploying AI models on cloud platforms.




Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI projects, from data acquisition to deployment and monitoring.
Design, build, and optimize Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Generative AI solutions.
Develop GenAI applications such as RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and Image Generation systems.
Architect scalable AI pipelines using MLOps tools and best practices.
Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams to deliver business-focused AI solutions.
Conduct code reviews, mentor junior engineers, and promote engineering best practices.
Stay updated on emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and industry trends.



Required Skills

5+ years of experience in AI/ML Engineering.
Strong proficiency in Python.
Expertise in LangChain and LangGraph.
Experience building GenAI solutions, including RAG, AI Agents, and Image Generation applications.
Strong understanding of LLMs, Prompt Engineering, and Agentic AI.
Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP).
Hands-on experience with cloud-based AI deployments.
Experience with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, and Kubernetes.



Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
Foundation-level certification in Artificial Intelligence.
